name: Quick Setup Cleaner
author: Md Fahad

sections.description:
Quick Setup Cleaner provides safe, one-click housekeeping tools for new WordPress sites.

Easily:
– Trash demo posts and pages
– Reset permalinks to “Post name” structure
– Sync timezone with your computer’s region
– Get guided links to review plugins and themes manually via the WordPress dashboard

Designed for agencies, developers, and freelancers who frequently set up new WordPress installations – saving time while keeping full control and security.

No tracking, no external calls, no upsells.
Built with security, performance, and WordPress coding standards in mind.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/quick-setup-cleaner/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Go to Tools → Quick Setup Cleaner to perform quick housekeeping actions.
sections.faq:
Does it delete plugins or themes automatically?

No. Following WordPress.org guidelines, the plugin only provides links and instructions to perform these actions manually in the dashboard.

Is it safe for production sites?

Yes — all destructive actions (like deleting posts or pages) are clearly confirmed before execution. The plugin never touches user data, media, or settings beyond what you choose.

Does it require Hello Elementor?

No, but it provides an option to easily switch to it manually, if you wish.

Is there any tracking or external API calls?

None. 100% self-contained and privacy-friendly.
